newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Auto says 9-5 costs on par with rest.
newsitem.headline: Saab Auto says 9-5 costs on par with rest.

text.p: Swedish car maker Saab Auto said on Thursday that the development costs of its new 9-5 model, expected to be launched in June this year, were not seen higher than any other models.

"Development costs for the Saab 9-5 model will not be significantly different from other Saab models and have even been somewhat lower than for earlier models," Saab Auto managing director Robert Hendry told a news conference.
The 9-5 model will be launched with a new generation Saab Ecopower engine. All engines are turbocharged.
One of the engines is Saab's newly developed assymetric turbocharged V6 motor which was shown for the first time in Frankfurt 1995.
"It is our aim to go as far as possible in the development of new turbo engines," Hendry said.
He said these engines could also be used by General Motors .
